title: MCP vs REST: Build the Same AI Tool and Test Every Failure
description:
A complete, reproducible comparison of REST and MCP using the same validated inventory lookup. We execute a real HTTP endpoint and a real MCP stdio session, inspect initialize → tools/list → tools/call, reject invalid arguments, compare 50 results per path, and add an observability trace. Local latency numbers are loopback measurements, not a universal transport ranking.

MCP lifecycle specification: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/lifecycle
Official MCP Python SDK: https://py.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/
Reproducible server, client and evidence: https://github.com/luis-alberto-sanchez-arenas/automationopsai-video-resources
Synthetic Kokoro narration; original procedural visuals; no music or third-party footage.

#ModelContextProtocol #AIAgents #APIDesign #SoftwareArchitecture
